title: Chronica System Atlas Dispatch Journal
description: Write-ahead journal record for one dispatch transaction, written by scripts/system-atlas/dispatch-journal.mjs's prepareTransaction(). As of dispatch_contract_version 2 (B.2.1), each record lives at its OWN immutable path -- dispatch-journal/txn-<transaction_id>.json -- never a single shared well-known file; this is what makes journal identity generation-safe (a stale in-memory copy of one transaction can never be confused with, delete, or overwrite a different transaction's file; see the module's own header comment for the ABA race this closes). A record's existence on disk IS the PREPARED state of its transaction; applyTransaction() deletes it as the commit signal, or leaves it in place with a RECOVERY_CONFLICT outcome if any target file's current content matches neither before_hash nor after_hash (state diverged since prepare -- never overwritten). This is a RUNTIME artifact -- no file under the journal directory must ever be present in a committed tree (see scripts/system-atlas/validate.mjs's leftover-runtime-artifact check): a lingering journal file means a transaction crashed mid-flight and was never recovered, or hit a RECOVERY_CONFLICT requiring human inspection.
